comment: Authoring originals held outside game packaging. Owner direction 2026-10-27: the harpy and succubus/oni are future characters with in-world cultures; they are not discarded monsters. These 2026-08-02 exports retain the Meshy 24-joint biped rig and separate move libraries. Paths below are relative to this index, not Godot resources. Retained .import sidecars are historical provenance, not current import configuration. A reviewed integration must establish their runtime, culture, role and presentation before adding them to the installed resident roster. The lamia was requested but absent from the dump.

harpy.notes: Winged, taloned; wings skinned to the arm chain, so arm clips read as wing gestures.
